hindiArth: जिसके मन तन में गुरु के चरण बस जाते हैं,

englishMeaning: Enemies and pains do not even approach them.

englishMeaning: The painful noose of death and rebirth is snapped.

hindiArth: जिससे आनंद-खुशियाँ, कल्याण एवं सदैव सुख प्राप्त हुआ है और हमारे सभी कार्य सम्पन्न हो गए हैं।॥ १॥रहाउ॥
englishMeaning: I am blessed with bliss and happiness, emancipation and eternal peace. All my affairs have been resolved. ||1|| Pause ||

englishMeaning: The Lotus Feet of the Guru abide within my mind.
